concepts.name: What photosynthesis is
concepts.source_span: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants prepare their own food using sunlight, carbon dioxide and water.

questions.stem: What is photosynthesis?
options: The process by which green plants prepare their own food using sunlight, carbon dioxide and water
The process by which plants absorb minerals from the soil
The process by which plants lose water through their leaves
The process by which plants break down food to release energy
